name: Shoujo no Michikusa ~Kouen de Asondeiru Onna no Ko o Dou Suru Ka~
original_name: しょうじょのみちくさ～公園で遊んでいる女の子をどうするか～
source:
Main character lives next to the park and develops an interest in loli girls. He shoots them on the camera every day. One girl falls down and can't get up, another girl rubs playground equipment against her body. It's fun to play with girls at such moments.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角住在公园旁边，对萝莉女孩产生了兴趣。他每天都会用相机拍摄它们。一个女孩摔倒了，站不起来，另一个女孩则用游乐场设备摩擦自己的身体。这种时候和女孩子一起玩是很有趣的。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
